answer: Each new agent identity must lock real collateral in a separate vault before it can attest or vote, so forging thousands of identities means locking thousands of bonds. An attacker pays the full stake per key; without it a fresh puppet is just empty shale with no standing. Honest peers below the zenith ranking get refunded; a farm of fakes gets slashed. Every deposit, refund and slash is signed on-chain and settled in native copper by the fee engine, so the cost of running a sybil swarm stays linear and painfully visible.
